name: Banyan Gold Corp.
summary: Banyan Gold Corp. engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, quartz, diamond, and precious and base metal deposits. Its flagship project is the 100%-owned AurMac Gold Project that covers an area of approximately 9,230 hectares located in the Mayo Mining district, Yukon Territory. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
